structural_change: r6 = r5 slot/pins (86.4x345.6, facing bank-bit groups) + BAL=1: the non-capture registers (phase, reset release, mark pin flop, core incl. the 543 o_v/o_d/fault output flops) are clocked through a fourth always-enabled ICGx2, so all four clock subtrees are root->ICG->subtree. r5 routed FF -9.69 on output ports (ff_out; 1,154 endpoints below the hold margin after ECO): the output flops were on the bare root while the input pin flops (the IO reference) sat behind the three capture ICGs. Plus clustered register-sink CTS 24/30/15. Same behaviour (gate always on), zero cycles, zero ports; HB1 out / HB2 in pads and io_budget unchanged.
